{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Agricultural production and exports are central to the Republican agenda for jobs, growth, expanded trade, and prosperity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Because farmers and ranchers care for the land, the United States does not depend on foreign imports for sustenance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Americans spend a smaller percentage of their income on food than any other nation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"On average, one American farm produces enough food to feed 155 people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No other nation has been as generous with food aid to the needy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States has good reason to celebrate its domestic security in food.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States is the largest agricultural exporter in the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Agricultural exports are vital for other sectors of the economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Each dollar of agricultural exports generates another $1.27 in business activity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party is committed to expanding trade opportunities and opening new markets for agriculture.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Under a Republican president, America's trade negotiators will insist that global trading partners adhere to science-based standards with regard to food and health regulations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party will not tolerate the use of bogus science and scare tactics to bar American products from foreign markets.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party will not allow insufficient health and safety standards for products imported for consumption in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
